scenarios.given: Explicit objective, target, queue, mutation boundary, evidence, and stop condition
scenarios.expect: runner reports effective authorization and selects the first eligible item

scenarios.given: User asks for a normal local edit without autonomous authorization
Next eligible task crosses a credential or generated-exposure boundary
scenarios.expect: runner reduces the batch or pauses according to classification

scenarios.given: Schema validation fails with a scoped behavior-preserving fix
scenarios.expect: runner fixes, reruns affected checks, and records evidence

scenarios.given: Three materially different attempts fail for one signature
scenarios.expect: runner records attempts and pauses blocked

scenarios.given: Durable state proves the transition already completed
A non-OpenSpec adapter supplies work items and evidence gates
scenarios.expect: runner reuses authorization, batching, correction, review, and checkpoint behavior
